meta.name: Quantum · GRH
meta.regime: Horizontally isogenous ordinary elliptic curves over F_q
meta.rules: L_q[α,c]=exp((c+o(1))(ln q)^α(ln ln q)^{1−α}). Compare the leading constant at α=1/2 only. Account for the quantum evaluation of the hiding functions. CJS has an acknowledged erratum to its claimed polynomial-quantum-space variant.
